svg.title: Earth — the element mark
svg.desc: A stone on the ground line, and the ground going down in narrowing strata under it. Water is these lines moving; earth is them holding still. Stone, root, patience. At home in hills, barrows and old woods. Generated by tools/build-icons.mjs from data/arcana.json and data/components.json - do not edit. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
